issue.title: bead_task_triage cannot create snooze gates because shared kwargs include unsupported closed_at
issue.description:
During the authorized 57-task notification review, the supported command `sase axe chop run bead_task_triage -V` logged `Failed to create gate for gh_sase-org__sase:sase-po: create_bead_snooze_gate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'closed_at'` on 2026-09-06 at 15:25 EDT. The overall chop returned success, leaving the snoozed task without its wake gate.

Root cause verified on SASE a45669b26: `_bead_task_triage_gates.create_gate` includes `closed_at` in the common kwargs passed to both task and snooze factories. The real `create_bead_snooze_gate` signature has no such parameter. Align the caller/factory contract and exercise the real snooze factory in a regression test so permissive stubs cannot hide signature drift. Do not modify sase-po's status to work around the missing gate. Small size: precise deterministic keyword mismatch in one factory dispatch path, with a bounded regression.

No duplicate found after bug-only then all-type searches and the last-week task sweep. sase-w9 concerns an expired test fixture and is related but distinct. Inspected active epics; the shared keyword predates their work and no causal owner was found.

task_type_fields.impact: Snoozed tasks cannot receive their wake gate; the chop reports overall success while logging a per-gate TypeError.
task_type_fields.repro: Run sase axe chop run bead_task_triage -V with a snoozed task (observed sase-po on 2026-09-06); the real snooze factory rejects closed_at.

payload.description: Both exercise the real snooze gate path; this runtime keyword mismatch is distinct from the expired test fixture.
